comments.content: The previous code cast any non-IContextItem to CommandContextItemViewModel, which would throw InvalidCastException for unexpected types. The new code silently returns null for unknown types. Verify that downstream consumers of this array handle null entries correctly (e.g., filtering or null checks), otherwise this could introduce NullReferenceExceptions later. If nulls are not expected downstream, consider filtering them out with `.Where(x => x is not null)` or throwing a meaningful exception.
